items.issue: A person begging on the street is used as proof that being oneself has no value.
items.disposition: Do not turn economic status into a ranking of human worth.

items.issue: A hug is presented as simple reassurance once attraction exists.
items.disposition: Attraction is not consent; require freely given present permission for contact.

items.issue: The clip treats attraction as the factor that converts identical contact or messages from harassment into reassurance.
items.disposition: Do not present as a causal rule; respect expressed welcome, refusal and communication boundaries.

items.issue: Death is minimized through an unverified claim of immortal souls and reincarnation.
items.disposition: Do not use in crisis, medical or self-harm guidance; preserve only as his spiritual belief.

items.issue: Both edited passages already exist in formal mikey-youtube-live-009.
